observations: body L1-L3: the end of the sentence begun on p. 318. «Yāqūt», «Ibn al–Wardī» and «Lelewel» are letter-spaced; «al–Wardī» has a long dash (5.5 pt).
body L4: the dash after «b)» measures 9.8 pt. The place is p. 137, L20 of the translation and what follows: the picture of the sundial («Haec est sciotherici imago»).

body L5-L10: «Schiaparelli» is letter-spaced; the A of «Azimuth» (L7) prints broken. «37–38» and «ar–Raqqah» have long dashes (5.3 pt each). The coordinates are those of the geographical table of vol. II: Mekkah, No. 103 on pp. 37-38, has the longitude 71° 0′ in the table, with the words «iuxta quod probatum est 77° 53′», and the latitude 21° 40′; ar-Raqqah, No. 150 on p. 41, has 73° 15′ and 36° 0′. The two rows are set at their printed places.

body L11-L13: the difference of the two longitudes is 4° 38′ in the table; with the modern longitudes of ar-Raqqah (39° 01′ E) and Mekkah (39° 50′ E) it is about 49′, as printed («50′ fere»). «longitu-» has a hyphen (2.6 pt).

body L14-L15: «Graecis» and «Fr. Woepcke» are letter-spaced. «archaeologico–mathematicae» has a long dash (about 5.5 pt, joined to the o); the dot of the i of «mathematicae» prints as a short bar, like ī.

body L16-L18: «Muḥam-» and «mad ibn ‘Omar ibn al–Farrukhān», «Muḥammad ibn Mūsà al–Khuwārizmī», «al–Far-» and «ghānī», «Ḥabash», «al–Adamī» and «Thābit ibn Qurrah» are letter-spaced; «al–Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad» is not. The dashes of «al–Farrukhān», «al–Khuwārizmī», «al–Far-», «al–Ḥusayn» and «al–Adamī» measure 5.4, 4.9, 5.3, 4.2 and 5.4 pt; the hyphens of «Muḥam-» and «al–Far-» 2.6 and 3.4 pt. «Mūsà» is printed with a grave accent on the a.

body L19-L20: a speck stands to the right of the head (L19), outside the measure. The dash after «a)» measures 8.2 pt. The place is p. 141, L37 of the translation, where the bearings of the poles of the armillary sphere answer «equulo in polo astrolabii (a) infixo».

body L21-L29: «al–quṭb», «al–miḥwar», «al–faras» and «al–Battānī» (L29) have long dashes (5.4, 5.4, 5.2 and 5.3 pt); «al–Battānī» is letter-spaced. «astro-» has a hyphen (2.5 pt). A full stop, not a comma, stands after «clavus» (L22), though the sentence runs on. The figure of the equulus stands on the right of L24-L27 and is redrawn from the print as the traced outline of its ink (23.4 by 41.9 pt): the pin with its pointed head, the head of a horse on its left and a curved wing on its right, on a flat base; the blanks inside the pin, its head and its base are left open. After «alhidadae» (L27) a raised mark like an apostrophe stands against the word, and a comma stands at the right edge of the measure, beyond the figure; one comma is set after the word. The n and t of «vocantes» (L27) print joined. The place p. 144, L1 of the translation is «se polo (1), firmato quasi esset polus astrolabii», with the note «I. e. axe».
body L30-L32: the dash after «b)» measures 10.2 pt; «139-141» has a hyphen (3.6 pt). The picture of the armillary sphere of which note 2 speaks stands on p. 320.

notes_left L1-L5: the Spanish of the Libros del saber is set as printed, with «astrolábio», «está» and «clauo» and the full stops before «et». The 4 of «264» (L1) prints in part; a speck stands under the a of «ma-» (L3). The hyphens of «fo-» and «ma-» measure 1.6 and 1.7 pt.

notes_right L1-L5: the end of note 1, with «traspásalas», «cauallet» and «pedaço» as printed. «Schia-» and «parelli» are letter-spaced; the hyphens of «di-» and «Schia-» measure 1.8 and 1.7 pt. The thin rule between the columns prints broken.
